主要内容: Genesis Motor America reported sales of 2,167 units in November 2019, a 420% increase compared to the prior year. Sales of all three Genesis models were up significantly over the prior year. The company also introduced the 2020 Genesis G90 sedan to the U.S. market at the Los Angeles Auto Show, with plans to launch it later in the month. The new model will feature a full styling update and numerous technological and safety innovations. Genesis has won highest-ranked brand awards for quality and owner satisfaction from industry experts such as J.D. Power, AutoPacific, and Strategic Vision. The G70 luxury sport sedan has garnered broad acclaim, being named the 2019 North American Car of the Year, the MotorTrend 2019 Car of the Year, and a category winner in the Car and Driver 2019 10Best awards, among more than a dozen others.
